description: This file defines an interface named ConsoleConfigurationInterface within the OrangeHRM Framework Console namespace. The interface declares a method registerCommands that is intended to register commands for a Console object, serving as a configuration contract for console command registration in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ConsoleConfigurationInterface
classes.description: An interface that enforces the implementation of the registerCommands method for configuring console commands.

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Method to register commands with a given Console object.
